observations: Photo 0: Freestanding cooker, glass lid propped open, 4 ring-type gas burners around edges and 2 round solid hotplates in the middle, stainless/steel body with wear and discoloration, oven below not visible here.

Photo 1: Close-up with glass lid open, all 4 gas burners show lit blue flame; the 2 round solid hotplates in the centre are not glowing or otherwise shown active; a cable is visible hanging from the back right, presumably power cord for the electric plates.

Photo 2: Full front view of the cooker with glass lid closed, oven compartment door open below showing an empty interior with a wooden stick wedged as a prop; control panel has a row of knobs (count unclear, some gaps possible), general surface rust/stains and wear visible.
No brand name, logo, or model number legible in any photo.
No shot shows the oven interior heating, the two round plates glowing/hot, or any wiring/plug clearly.

identity.kind: gas cooker with oven, 4 gas burners + 2 electric hotplates

claims.claim: 4 gas cooker and 2 burner making 6 burner in total
claims.evidence: photo 0 and photo 1 show 4 ring gas burners plus 2 round solid hotplates, totalling 6 cooking points
photo 1 shows only the 4 gas burners lit with flame; the 2 electric hotplates and the oven are not shown operating in any photo

risks.proof: A photo or short clip of the hotplates glowing red/hot when powered

risks.risk: Oven may not heat or thermostat may be faulty
risks.proof: A photo/clip of the oven interior glowing or a thermometer reading after preheating
A clear close-up of the full control panel showing all knobs present and intact
risks.if_unproven: priced as if one or more knobs missing

risks.risk: Gas leakage or hose/regulator condition not shown
risks.proof: A photo of the gas hose, regulator, and connection point at the back

risks.risk: Electrical cord/plug condition for the hotplates is unclear
risks.proof: A clear photo of the plug and cord end, undamaged

risks.risk: Interior oven wiring/heating element condition hidden by prop stick in photo 2
risks.proof: A clear photo of the oven interior without obstruction, showing the heating elements

Video of the oven being turned on and heating up, ideally with a thermometer
Clear close-up of the full control panel showing all knobs intact
Photo of the gas hose and regulator connection at the back
Photo of the power plug and cord in full, undamaged
response.reason: The item is clearly identifiable as a 6-point gas/electric combo cooker with oven; gas burners are shown working but the electric hotplates and oven are unverified, so it is priced at worst case for those parts while gas burners are credited as functional.
